blocks.text: Thermodynamics ka pehla law batata hai ke heat energy utne hi work mein badal sakti hai, magar yeh nahi batata ke yeh change (badlao) kin conditions (shartom) par hoti hai. Doosra law batata hai ke heat kin halaat mein work ban sakti hai aur heat kis direction (rukh) mein behti hai.

Doosre law ka formal statement (baqaida bayan) karne se pehle engine ka asal kaam dekhte hain. Engine ya system (Fig. 6.8) temperature T₁ wale heat source se heat Q₁ leta hai. Woh work W karta hai aur temperature T₂ wale thande reservoir ko heat Q₂ de deta hai. Working substance ek cyclic process se guzar kar aakhir apni shuru wali halat mein wapas aa jata hai, is liye us ki internal energy ki change zero hai. Is liye pehle law se net work net absorb (andar le lena) ki hui heat ke barabar hai, yani:

blocks.alt: Oopar Hot reservoir T1 ka dabba; us se chaura laal teer Q1 neeche narangi sitare Heat engine mein. Engine se daen taraf hari patti Output Work = W mur kar teer banti hai. Engine se patli neeli patti Q2 neeche Cold reservoir T2 ke dabbe mein.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.8: Heat engine ka khaaka. Engine garam reservoir se heat Q1 leta hai, thande reservoir ko Q2 deta hai aur work W karta hai (kitab ki figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka; kitab mein 'Fig. 6.10' chhapa hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein is figure ke neeche ghalti se “Fig. 6.10” chhapa hai, jab ke text ise Fig. 6.8 kehta hai (Fig. 6.10 asal mein refrigerator ki figure hai). Yahan ise Figure 6.8 likha gaya hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Garam reservoir se aane wali heat Q₁ ka kuch hissa work W banta hai aur baqi Q₂ thande reservoir ko chali jati hai. Is liye W = Q₁ − Q₂.

Asal mein motor car ka petrol engine jalte fuel se heat leta hai, us ka kuch hissa mechanical energy ya work mein badalta hai aur baqi atmosphere (hawa ki teh) mein nikal deta hai. Dekha gaya hai ke petrol engine milne wali heat ka taqreeban 25% aur diesel engine 35 se 40% work mein badalte hain.
Thermodynamics ka doosra law inhi observations par based ek formal statement hai. Ise kai tareeqon se likha ja sakta hai:
Heat engine ke kaam par based Lord Kelvin ka statement (bayan):

blocks.title: Kelvin ka statement
blocks.text: Aisa koi process banana namumkin hai jo sirf ek reservoir se li hui heat ko poori ki poori work mein badal de aur working system mein koi change na chhore.

Is ka matlab hai ke sirf ek heat reservoir, chahe us mein kitni hi energy ho, se work nahi liya ja sakta. Samandar aur hamari atmosphere mein bohat heat energy hai, magar use useful (faidemand) mechanical work mein nahi badla ja sakta. Doosre law ka result yeh hai ke heat ko work banane ke liye mukhtalif temperature wali do cheezein zaroori hain: heat engine ke liye high temperature par heat ka source aur low temperature par ek sink (jahan heat phenki ja sake) hona chahiye. Samandar aur atmosphere ki heat hum is liye istemal nahi kar sakte ke in dono se kam temperature wala koi reservoir mojood nahi.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Kelvin ke bayan ke mutabiq yahan dikhaya gaya process namumkin hai: ek hi temperature wale source ki heat poori ki poori work nahi ban sakti.

blocks.alt: Akela laal reservoir Temperature T; us se narangi patti Heat in, neeche teer ke sath, kale circle (gol chakkar) Heat engine mein, jis ki nikalti patti par work likha hai. Poore khaake par neela forbidden (prohibition) nishan hai jis ke kinare par IMPOSSIBLE likha hai.
blocks.caption: Tidbits (PDF page 130): yahan dikhaya gaya process namumkin hai; ek hi temperature wale source ki heat poori ki poori work mein nahi badal sakti (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh Kelvin ka statement hai: sirf ek reservoir se heat le kar saari ki saari work mein badalna namumkin hai. Engine ko kaam karne ke liye ek thanda reservoir (sink) bhi chahiye jahan kuch heat chhori jaye, jaisa Figure 6.8 mein.

blocks.prompt: Doosre law ko do tareeqon se bayan karein. Kya koi cyclic engine ek hi temperature par heat le kar use poora work bana sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Kelvin: ek hi reservoir se li hui heat ko working system mein change chhore baghair poora work nahi banaya ja sakta. Clausius: heat khud ba khud thandi cheez se garam cheez ki taraf nahi behti. Nahi: cyclic engine ko kuch heat thande sink ko deni hi parti hai, warna Kelvin ka statement toot jayega; sirf ek source engine nahi chala sakta.

items: Engine: T₁ par Q₁ leta hai, W karta hai, T₂ par Q₂ deta hai; W = Q₁ − Q₂ (petrol taqreeban 25%, diesel 35 se 40%).
Kelvin: ek reservoir ki heat poori work nahi ban sakti; source aur sink, do mukhtalif temperatures, zaroori hain, is liye samandar aur atmosphere engine nahi chala sakte.
